'''Quench-gourds''' were [[Plant/Legends|plants]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]],<ref name="TBHC" /> a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kalevalan quench-gourds were known to split open when they became overly ripe.<ref name="TBHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The quench-gourd was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] via a mention in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]-centric reference guide co-[[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Ryder Windham]], published [[October 15]], [[2013]].
